tiles.note: Cover at 1:1: İHKD mono wordmark at 80 (same mark as the nav), journal line + issue, coverline 44, congress date 30; EKG plate 640x220 with 8/40px grid, three leads I/II/V1, labels and 25 mm/s · 10 mm/mV caption; TOC page numbers sit on the names' baselines; CTA at 760 and imprint 13 inside the sheet; sheet edges 120/1320, bottom 880; no photo.

Cover bottom is the sheet's own 1px edge at 880, then 112px paper to the Gündem head at 992 — no strip, no glued joint. Gündem rows share one top per row (date/category/title/time), rule ends at 1320.
Group rows: rules land on the block bottom edge, index and arrow on the column edges; academy meta ends at 1200 and Başla at 1320; no overflow or crossing.
Academy tail + publication: book photo 280x300 (publication object), TOC rows from rows(), both links on one line; guideline ECG strip 360x44 reads as data; no collision with the column rule.
Membership white band: bullets, link, fee line; footer at the board end, legal line right-aligned to 1320; no trailing canvas void.
